gen-mystery-quest-gf-ramabhadra: Old storybook charm: Mystery Quest leaves a gap in every curved stroke and tucks its ascenders in tight. Ramabhadra, a sans-serif with a prominent x-height, carries paragraphs along without any fuss.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-sofia-sans-condense: Mystery Quest leaves open jaws on every curved stroke. Sofia Sans Condensed has a big x-height and curves that stop short of closing, so paragraphs flow smoothly with no calligraphic shading to steer the eye.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-strait: Bookish and nostalgic, Mystery Quest opens a jaw on every curve and keeps its ascenders compact. Strait, a sans with big round lowercase bowls, reads comfortably through paragraph after paragraph.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-viga: Compact ascenders sit over tall lowercase in Mystery Quest. Viga, its capitals barely taller than neighbors and its strokes free of hairlines, gives that bookish texture a sturdy partner.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-voces: Storybook nostalgia, with a gap in every curve: that is Mystery Quest. And Voces, a sans built tall in the lowercase with stems and hairlines in close ratio, is the sturdy counterweight.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-yantramanav: Yantramanav reads modern and clean, a sans-serif with spacious terminal gaps and lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. And Mystery Quest supplies the bookish, nostalgic side through open-jawed curves and compact ascenders.
gen-mystery-quest-outfit: Mystery Quest opens a jaw on every curved stroke, with compact ascenders sitting above its tall lowercase, giving a bookish, nostalgic look. Outfit bends its curves like cable, stopping short of closing.
gen-mystery-quest-plus-jakarta-sans: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest leaves open jaws on its curves. And Plus Jakarta Sans, monoline throughout with well-parted curve endings, sits moderately lower in the lowercase, giving the heading room to stand out.
gen-mystery-quest-sora: Mystery Quest has a bookish, nostalgic look, with open jaws on every curve. Sora, geometric and precise with no pressure swell at its corners, keeps paragraphs reading steadily.
gen-mystery-quest-space-grotesk: Nostalgic, bookish, a little gap-toothed: Mystery Quest leaves every curve open and keeps its ascenders compact over tall lowercase. Mystery Quest sets the mood; Space Grotesk, constant in width, does the reading.
